The shift at 4.43 ppm could be indicative of a proton adjacent to an oxygen atom, such as in an alcohol or ether. The shifts at 5.04 ppm and 6.05 ppm suggest the presence of vinylic protons, which are common in alkenes. To further refine the structure, I will obtain the IR spectra to identify any functional groups, such as carbonyls, that might be present.</thought>

Given the data from the NMR and IR spectra, the molecule likely contains an aromatic ring, an alcohol group, and a carbonyl group.
